dependency_scope.reason: Runtime roots plus complete declared Windows dependencies, including required tensordict[zarr]; unrelated applications excluded for clean pip check

resource_proposal.stage_policy: Fail closed on resource guard; preserve interrupted staging; no repeated automatic retries during active model training

steps.action: Inspect exact current source hashes, explicit metadata paths, local wheel availability, disk and inheritance

Resolve official metadata and binary-wheel availability against exact constraints; recover matching cached wheels first. Record package/version, URL, tags, size, publisher SHA where available, observed bytes SHA and cache provenance. Do not build from source.

Create a separate venv without --system-site-packages. Clear PYTHONPATH/PYTHONHOME/PIP_USER; disable user-site. Use the existing CPython base executable. No old .pth files or package directories are copied.

Retrieve only unresolved binary wheels, including the exact official Torch wheel if unavailable locally. Stream downloads and hashes, preserve exact URL/SHA/size. Generate a complete --require-hashes lock; install from an offline wheelhouse with --no-index --only-binary=:all:. Never update/uninstall global packages.

Use isolated environment pip check; require zero missing/conflicting dependencies. Verify pyvenv.cfg false, no external .pth path, user site disabled and no old environment/global/user package paths. Compare all recorded core source hashes without importing frameworks.

Import frameworks only in the allocated slot. Log actual imported module files/versions under the clean venv; standard library and application source are separately identified. Run tiny train-only CUDA forward/backward/update checks for needed model families. Do not call this full training reproduction.

Reload one already-frozen validation checkpoint and compare its existing validation anchor with recorded tolerance/hashes. No held-out test, retuning or repeat full experiments. Report exactly which architecture/anchor was checked.

known_limits: Exact Torch wheel is absent in the bounded caches checked; about 2.59GB retrieval may be necessary after approval
